motion.name: detail-reveal
motion.purpose: Inline details reveal from clip-path inset(0 0 100% 0) to inset(0). Reduced-motion preference disables all animations and transitions and restores automatic scrolling.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Canonical accent action; enabled preview is synthetic, not an unlocked lab feature.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; justify-content:center; align-items:center; gap:8px; min-height:40px; padding:9px 16px; border:1px solid var(--cp-accent); border-radius:10px; background:var(--cp-accent); color:var(--cp-accent-fg); font-family:"Segoe UI",Aptos,Calibri,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,sans-serif; font-size:0.875rem; font-weight:600; white-space:nowrap; cursor:pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover:not(:disabled) { background:var(--cp-accent-hover); border-color:var(--cp-accent-hover); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--cp-accent); outline-offset:4px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { background:var(--cp-surface); color:var(--cp-text-muted); border-color:var(--cp-border); cursor:not-allowed; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display:inline-flex; justify-content:center; align-items:center; gap:8px; min-height:40px; padding:9px 16px; border:1px solid var(--cp-border); border-radius:10px; background:var(--cp-surface); color:var(--cp-text); font-family:"Segoe UI",Aptos,Calibri,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,sans-serif; font-size:0.875rem; font-weight:600; white-space:nowrap; cursor:pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover:not(:disabled) { background:var(--cp-surface-soft); border-color:var(--cp-border-strong); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--cp-accent); outline-offset:4px; } .ds-btn-secondary:disabled { color:var(--cp-text-muted); cursor:not-allowed; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Labeled title field with synthetic content and the observed character limit.
components.html: 1–80 characters. Your API validates this too.
components.css: .ds-field { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:8px; min-width:0; font-family:"Segoe UI",Aptos,Calibri,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,sans-serif; color:var(--cp-text); font-size:0.875rem; line-height:1.5; } .ds-field label { font-size:0.8125rem; font-weight:600; } .ds-field input { height:44px; padding:10px 12px; border:1px solid var(--cp-border); border-radius:10px; background:var(--cp-surface); color:var(--cp-text); width:100%; font:inherit; } .ds-field input::placeholder { color:var(--cp-text-muted); opacity:1; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--cp-accent); outline-offset:4px; } .ds-field input:disabled { cursor:not-allowed; } .ds-field-help { color:var(--cp-text-muted); font-size:0.75rem; } :host-context(html[data-theme="dark"]) .ds-field-help { color:var(--cp-text-soft); }

components.name: Navigation Item
components.description: Selected queue with an inline icon, synthetic count and persistent accessible name.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; width:100%; min-height:44px; margin:4px 0; padding:10px 12px; background:none; border:0; border-radius:10px; color:var(--cp-text-muted); text-align:left; font-family:"Segoe UI",Aptos,Calibri,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,sans-serif; font-size:0.875rem; line-height:1.5; cursor:pointer; } .ds-nav-item:hover:not(:disabled) { color:var(--cp-text); background:var(--cp-surface-soft); } .ds-nav-item.ds-selected { color:var(--cp-accent); background:var(--cp-accent-soft); font-weight:600; } .ds-nav-icon { width:20px; height:20px; flex:0 0 auto; fill:none; stroke:currentColor; stroke-width:1.6; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round; } .ds-nav-count { margin-left:auto; font-size:0.75rem; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--cp-accent); outline-offset:4px; } .ds-nav-item:disabled { color:var(--cp-text-muted); cursor:not-allowed; } :host-context(html[data-theme="dark"]) .ds-nav-item { color:var(--cp-text-soft); } :host-context(html[data-theme="dark"]) .ds-nav-item.ds-selected { color:var(--cp-text); } :host-context(html[data-theme="dark"]) .ds-selected > .ds-nav-icon { color:var(--cp-accent); }

components.name: Status Indicator
components.description: Noninteractive word-and-icon status, without a pill background or invented interaction.
components.html: Open
components.css: .ds-status { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; font-family:"Segoe UI",Aptos,Calibri,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,sans-serif; font-size:0.75rem; line-height:1.5; white-space:nowrap; color:var(--cp-text); } .ds-status-icon { width:15px; height:15px; fill:none; stroke:currentColor; stroke-width:1.6; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round; } .ds-status-open .ds-status-icon { color:var(--cp-accent); } .ds-status-resolved .ds-status-icon { color:var(--cp-success); }

clip-path:inset(50%); white-space:nowrap; } .ds-table th { text-align:left; padding:16px 20px; font-size:0.75rem; font-weight:500; color:var(--cp-text-muted); border-bottom:1px solid var(--cp-border); } .ds-ticket-row.ds-expanded { background:var(--cp-accent-soft); } .ds-ticket-code { font-family:Consolas,"Courier New",Courier,monospace; font-size:0.75rem; color:var(--cp-text-muted); white-space:nowrap; } .ds-ticket-title { display:inline-block; padding:4px 0; background:none; color:var(--cp-text); border:0; font:inherit; font-weight:500; text-align:left; line-height:1.5; overflow-wrap:anywhere; cursor:pointer; } .ds-ticket-title:hover { color:var(--cp-accent); } .ds-ticket-title:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--cp-accent); outline-offset:4px; border-radius:3px; } .ds-ledger-status { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; font-size:0.75rem; white-space:nowrap; } .ds-ledger-status svg { width:15px; height:15px; fill:none; stroke:var(--cp-accent); stroke-width:1.6; } .ds-details-row td { padding:0; background:var(--cp-bg-elevated); } .ds-ticket-detail { display:grid; grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(180px,0.65fr); gap:40px; padding:28px 32px 28px 136px; animation:ds-detail-reveal 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } @keyframes ds-detail-reveal { from { clip-path:inset(0 0 100% 0); } to { clip-path:inset(0); } } .ds-detail-heading { font-size:0.875rem; font-weight:600; line-height:1.4; letter-spacing:-0.015em; margin:0 0 16px; } .ds-detail-facts { display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr)); gap:20px; margin:0; } .ds-detail-facts dt { font-size:0.6875rem; color:var(--cp-text-muted); margin-bottom:8px; } .ds-detail-facts dd { margin:0; font-size:0.8125rem; overflow-wrap:anywhere; } .ds-detail-link { display:inline-flex; gap:6px; align-items:center; color:var(--cp-accent); font-size:0.75rem; margin-top:24px; text-decoration:none; } .ds-detail-link:hover { text-decoration:underline; } .ds-detail-link:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--cp-accent); outline-offset:4px; } .ds-detail-actions { padding-left:24px; border-left:1px solid var(--cp-border); } .ds-detail-actions p { margin:10px 0 0; font-size:0.75rem; color:var(--cp-text-muted); } .ds-ledger-footer { padding:16px 20px; color:var(--cp-text-muted); font-size:0.75rem; background:var(--cp-bg-elevated); } :host-context(html[data-theme="dark"]) :is(.ds-table th,.ds-ticket-code,.ds-detail-facts dt,.ds-detail-actions p,.ds-ledger-footer) { color:var(--cp-text-soft); } @media(max-width:1180px) { .ds-id-column { width:96px; } .ds-status-column { width:112px; } .ds-table td,.ds-table th { padding-left:16px; padding-right:16px; } .ds-ticket-detail { padding-left:32px; gap:24px; } } @media(max-width:900px) { .ds-ticket-detail { grid-template-columns:1fr; gap:20px; } .ds-detail-actions { padding:20px 0 0; border-left:0; border-top:1px solid var(--cp-border); } } @media(max-width:640px) { .ds-table,.ds-table tbody { display:block; } .ds-table thead { display:none; } .ds-ticket-row { display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr auto; padding:20px; gap:8px 12px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--cp-border); } .ds-ticket-row td { padding:0; border:0; } .ds-ticket-row td:nth-child(1) { grid-column:1; grid-row:1; } .ds-ticket-row td:nth-child(2) { grid-column:1 / -1; grid-row:2; padding-bottom:8px; } .ds-ticket-row td:nth-child(3) { grid-column:1; grid-row:3; } .ds-details-row,.ds-details-row > td { display:block; } .ds-details-row > td { padding:0; } .ds-ticket-detail { padding:24px 20px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--cp-border); } .ds-detail-facts { gap:12px; } } @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-ticket-detail { animation:none !important; transition:none !important; scroll-behavior:auto !important; } }

narrative.overview: A modern, clean, realistic workspace with quiet controls, fine rules and readable ticket records. The confirmed direction is a slim navigation rail and a full-width expandable ledger, not a marketing page.
keyCharacteristics: Warm-neutral surfaces and restrained rose accents.
Native controls and inline ticket inspection.
dos: Do preserve the exact Clawpilot theme values and use their custom properties.
Do use readable dark secondary text, explicit labels and accent focus outlines.
Do keep native mobile queue selection and stacked ticket records.
Do expose unfinished lab features without simulating API success.
donts: Don't replace the restrained workspace with a marketing page.
Don't add unobserved fonts, shadows, tonal ramps or operational claims.
